sections.title: Fall Cleanup for Southwick's Leaf-Covered Lawns
sections.body: Southwick's trees produce heavy leaf fall every autumn, and those leaves need to be removed before they smother lawns and create fungal problems. Our fall cleanup service clears leaves from lawns, beds, walkways, and driveways throughout Southwick. For properties near wooded areas or with extensive tree cover, we offer multiple fall visits to keep up with continuous drop. We also handle branch removal, bed cleanup, and winter preparation so your Southwick property enters the cold months in good condition.

sections.title: Spring Cleanup After Southwick Winters
sections.body: Southwick winters leave behind debris, broken branches, and lawns that need attention after months under snow or frost. For lakeside properties, we also check for erosion issues or drainage problems that winter storms may have caused. Spring cleanup gets your Southwick property ready for the outdoor season, whether that means backyard barbecues, lake activities, or just enjoying a tidy yard.

We handle the entire process so your property is clean and ready to enjoy when we finish.
